main.description: Service-internal. Hosted by bobbin. Given an entity at-uri or repo DID, returns the dids subscribed to it. deliberi calls this while ingesting the firehose to fan a notification out to subscribers.

collection.description: Optional collection NSID to filter subscribers by subscription scope. Only subscribers with no collection filter or a filter containing this NSID are returned.

subject.description: at-uri of the entity (for entity-level subscribers) or a repo DID (for repo-level subscribers).
